hints.title: Minute Simulation
hints.text: The number of minutes in a full twenty-four hour day is 1440, which is small enough to simulate minute by minute.

hints.title: Digit Verification
hints.text: Increment the current minute by one modulo 1440. Check if every digit in the candidate formatted time was present in the original input digits.

hints.title: First Valid Minute Match
hints.text: Convert HH:MM to total elapsed minutes from midnight. Advance one minute at a time up to 1440 times. The first time whose formatted digits are a subset of the allowed digits is the answer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Direct simulation advances minute by minute until valid digits match.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating and sorting all four-digit permutations requires extra validation of hour and minute validity bounds.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating at most 1440 integer increments takes constant time and memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model time as minutes from midnight modulo 1440 and verify candidate digits.
